IBM hires an Associate Application Developer to help organizations improve customer experiences, business processes, and operations through modern applications and Microsoft cloud technologies. The role contributes to client projects across industries while building technical expertise and consulting skills through structured learning, mentorship, and certifications.
Professional Services
Consulting
Government
Business Development
Comp. & Benefits
Responsibilities
As an Associate Application Developer at IBM, you'll help organizations transform how they serve customers, improve operations, and accelerate digital innovation through modern applications and cloud technologies
You could support healthcare, financial services, public sector, federal sector, automotive, energy, retail, industrial, or manufacturing clients
Through structured learning, mentorship, certifications, and hands-on client projects, you'll build specialized expertise within your assigned practice while developing the consulting, communication, and technical skills needed to solve complex business challenges
As part of our Microsoft practice, you'll work on solutions that leverage Microsoft technologies to improve customer experiences, business processes, and operational efficiency
You'll collaborate with experienced consultants, developers, architects, and AI specialists while gaining exposure to enterprise-scale projects across multiple industries
During your first year, you'll build technical expertise, earn certifications, contribute to client projects, strengthen your consulting and communication skills, and establish a strong foundation for long-term career growth at IBM

Required
Currently completing or recently completed a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field
Foundational knowledge of programming languages such as C#, Java, Python, JavaScript, or similar technologies
Understanding of software development, databases, APIs, cloud computing, and application architectures
Exposure to application development or cloud technologies through coursework, internships, research, projects, or personal learning
Familiarity with version control tools such as Git
Curiosity about Artificial Intelligence, cloud platforms, automation, and emerging technologies
You don't need to be an expert to get started. We're looking for individuals with a strong foundation, a growth mindset, and a desire to learn and make an impact
Preferred
Exposure to Azure, cloud computing, data solutions, or AI-related projects
Familiarity with APIs, databases, cloud-native architectures, or DevOps concepts
Interest in cloud innovation, Artificial Intelligence, and continuous learning
